name: Shiru o Kakerareru Shoujo ~Yarisute Gomen!? Seieki de Kioku o Kesu Otoko~
original_name: 精液をかけられる少女～犯り捨て御免!? 精液で記憶を消す男～
source:
I'm Akashi. The other day, my father suddenly told me, "You must get married soon after you graduate from school. I've already selected three fiancees for you. The girl you have sex with first will be your wife. That's all." Oh, my.... What? A parcel to me? What's this...? A new medicine? "I've invented a new medicine with which you can get an ability to erase other people's memory...." Oh, great! With this medicine, I'll be able to have sex with all three girls! Thank you!

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090914123427/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1013532]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
我是赤司。有一天，父亲突然对我说：“你一毕业就必须结婚，我已经给你选了三个未婚妻了，第一个和你发生关系的女孩就是你的妻子，仅此而已。”哦，我的……什么？给我一个包裹？这是什么……？新药？“我发明了一种新药，可以消除别人的记忆……”哦，太好了！有了这个药，我就可以和三个女孩都做爱了！谢谢你！
